code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    original = [row[:] for row in grid]
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*original[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*original)][::-1]
    upside_down = [row[::-1] for row in original[::-1]]
    return [original[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + upside_down[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
